createTableSql: CREATE TABLE account_icon (id int PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT nextval('account_icon_sequence'), title varchar(100), icon text);
createSeqSql: CREATE SEQUENCE IF NOT EXISTS account_icon_sequence START 1;

createTableSql: CREATE TABLE account_type (id int PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT nextval('account_type_sequence'), type_1 varchar(20), type_2 varchar(20), type_3 varchar(20));
createSeqSql: CREATE SEQUENCE IF NOT EXISTS account_type_sequence START 1;

createTableSql: CREATE TABLE account (id int PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT nextval('account_sequence'), type_id serial references account_type, icon_id serial references account_icon, name varchar(30) not null);
createSeqSql: CREATE SEQUENCE IF NOT EXISTS account_sequence START 1;

createTableSql: CREATE TABLE account_statement (id int PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT nextval('account_statement_sequence'), extension varchar(10) not null, version integer not null, start_time timestamp not null, end_time timestamp not null, account_id serial references account);
createSeqSql: CREATE SEQUENCE IF NOT EXISTS account_statement_sequence START 1;

createTableSql: CREATE TABLE user_detail (id int PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT nextval('user_detail_sequence'), name varchar(200) not null);
createSeqSql: CREATE SEQUENCE IF NOT EXISTS user_detail_sequence START 1;

createTableSql: CREATE TABLE user_account (id int PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT nextval('user_account_sequence'), account_id serial references account, user_id serial references user_detail, user_account_name varchar(300));
createSeqSql: CREATE SEQUENCE IF NOT EXISTS user_account_sequence START 1;

createTableSql: CREATE TABLE transaction (id text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL UNIQUE, date date not null, user_account_id serial not null references user_account, title varchar(100) not null, amount numeric not null, debit_credit_indicator varchar(2) not null, closing_balance numeric, category_id varchar(200), units numeric, price_per_unit numeric);
CREATE TABLE user_category (id int PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT nextval('user_category_sequence'), user_id serial references user_detail, category_title varchar(300));
createSeqSql: CREATE SEQUENCE IF NOT EXISTS user_category_sequence START 1;

createTableSql: CREATE TABLE transaction_user_category (id int PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT nextval('transaction_user_category_sequence'), transaction_id text references transaction, user_category_id serial references user_category, unique(transaction_id, user_category_id));
createSeqSql: CREATE SEQUENCE IF NOT EXISTS transaction_user_category_sequence START 1;
